ck: (26)kasitinanacarya evan civesapete pratyaksanunane apitayakananapyaha — srutayastviti na srutaya paranartikapete pranananityasankate — vyavahariketi srutyukto peto patyopatyo veti vikalpena tusayitun prcati — sa kiniti prananyan apatyartakatvan nanvaropitaneva srute prananyan kin tvaprahnacnanapatyatvat vyavahararhanityasankate — prananyaniti aprananyan = prananyapava paranartikaniti pavapavayorekasya patenyasyapatyatvaniyanatiti pava atrestapatinasankate — ka santeha iti tarhi pOtanatapravesaprasanka ityaha — astiti tatakato pOta svasya tatanuyayitvananapyupakacata ityarta suktirupyatyaksavatityuktatrstantapiprayanavicnaya sankate — nanviti satyapatasravanat pete satyatvasanarpakapatasravanat apotakatvaneva hyaprananyaprayocakan srutinan ca petasvarupapotakatvana tatanseprananyan tasya paranartikatvan tu na srutipotitan atastatanse tataprananyanisyata eveti pava svakocareti apatyartapotakatvanityarta ayan pava apotakatvavatvatyartapotakatvanapyaprananyaprayocakan anyata suktiracatakrahakatustentriyaterapi prananyaprasankat taca sruterapyavisistaniti tataprananyan turvaraneva na ca prahnacnanetarapatyapotakatvaneva prananyan taca srutisatarananiti vacyan sukticnanetarapatyapotakatvaneva prananyan, taca tustentriyasatarananityasyapi suvacatvat kinca yacrute prananyan tatpatyaneveti tatapavalaksanaprananyaprasankastatavasta eveti petasatyatvan na srutyuktanityetatusayati — satyapatasravanatiti tva suparnetyatavityati tatanankikare petasatyatvanankikare na syatiti ayanasaya satvasatvotasinapratityapavatuktasrutyapi satvenEva petapratite sanpavati srutestatsatyatve prananyan anyata sruteratvEtasvarupanatrakrahakatvapatya satyatvakrahakatvatatvEtanapi tava patyan syatiti nanu sruteratvEtasvarupanatrakrahakatvepi tatsatyatvanupakranatitatparyalinkEravasiyate na tu petasatyatvanityasankate — ateti `sateva sonyetanakra asi`tekanevatvitiyanityupakrana `Etatatnyanitan sarvanityupasanhara `tatvanasiti navakrtvopyasa Ekyasya nanantarapraptatvatapurvata `ata sanpatsyata iti palan `yenasrutan srutan pavatityartavata iti
